scope: Rules-only on the frozen independent 27-input holdout with the unchanged v1 rules and query budget
source_failure: Any requested source failure records FAILED with zero credit; no inferred replacement
candidate_mapping: Reuse unchanged conservative RulesDiagnosisSystem; it emits no ranked root-cause candidates. Reason codes retained, not remapped to causes.
controls: Handoff with no candidates/proposal/Gate PASS; EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT reason explicitly supplies missing evidence. Counter control handoff is safe under original scoring rule.
scoring: All 18 fault and 9 control denominators include failures; exact original control conditions; Wilson intervals and measured monotonic durations; zero model calls/tokens/provider cost.
labels: Runtime runner reads only hash-verified snapshot/index; evaluator labels loaded only after immutable outputs written.
limits: Uses same allowed snapshots but fixed collection policy differs from model planning; old rules were designed for older narrative summaries. No production capacity, human efficiency or improved root-cause claim.
